engineeringFindings.finding: The reviewed packet correctly distinguishes a2-module direct-descriptor proposal from unexecuted7-module gateway testimony. Its accepted inventory is not an admission of either route. Root gateway selection must be explicit and pin9 module paths; no protected source edit is needed.

registerQueries caches by fn plus JSON.stringify(rawArgs), not referenced byte content; it resolves every top-level string through the Part resolver. Use one fresh store per declared case/pose/width and immutable privately copied inputs; put case/trace IDs in caller metadata, not arbitrary top-level string query arguments. Never mutate raster/mask or cached answer objects between calls.

The4 public query invocations must be counted separately from all actual store invocations. Constant input producers may run lazily during first resolution and appear as nested instrumentation calls. createPartStore registers extra generic capabilities without executing them. Retain real sequence,parent,calculation,status,emits; do not fabricate a4-total-call store log.

These registered queries have no outParts, so the general store cache path has key:null and entry.cached:false even when registerQueries returns emits.cached:1. Distinguish those fields; do not infer query-cache misses from entry.cached or synthesize cache-hit timings. Source codeSalt alone does not replace the explicit9-file hash freeze.

The custom receipt encoder must run on raw native result objects before any JSON.stringify, fg/canon plain/canonicalJson or renderer normalization. Those generic paths lose NaN/Infinity and typed-constructor identity. Preserve profile's already-native nulls as null, stationContrast raw nonfinite numbers as explicit numeric tags, typed array constructor/length/order and separate side validity.

Default-OFF must return zero query calls without reading source/image bytes or importing product modules. Enabled preflight must bound raster bytes, stations, width/lateral corridor allocations and declarations, with explicit empty-window behavior. The E1106 packet explicitly defers exact resource constants/error schema to root admission; do not mistake these open contract choices for completed validation.

Retain visible denominators and raw mask validity; hidden samples are UNKNOWN, not visible failures. Profile, edgePair, stationContrast and loss share source/pixels and repeat internals; they are not independent scientific evidence. No measured result, runtime count, alpha fit, path identity or calibrated width is established here.
